plan: A sulky mage who terrifies her enemies and especially punishes those who dash.
aSurveiller: Her R (Shadow Surge). She marks you, then dashes at you: if you die, she can recast it right away.
contrer: Avoid dashing near her: she marks you to fear you.
Dodge her R: the mark lets her dash at you.
Engage her once her W is used: it's her shield.
forces: Her R resets after a takedown.
faiblesses: Her spells are easy to see coming.

sorts.R: Marks a champion then dashes to them.
